title: You Don't Need Any Tools
about: An elaborate locked-barrel Christmas puzzle meets an uncle with an angle grinder.
description: In a family where wrapping presents is a competitive sport, a normal box and ribbon were never going to be enough. You Don't Need Any Tools follows a Christmas gift hidden behind a carefully designed challenge involving a barrel, ten padlocks, and a key concealed within a trail of clues. The whole point was to solve the puzzle using thought and patience rather than brute force. Unfortunately, the uncle receiving it had his own approach and an angle grinder. The result is a hilarious clash between elaborate planning and spectacularly direct problem-solving.
